meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按你的话操作浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表等,并保留页面状态,复杂任务可分步完成。
howto.when: 当你说“打开网址”“点击”“填表单”等浏览器操作词,或要求截图、抓取数据等时触发;用户已登录网站时可接管现有 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截一张全页截图
say.note: 会启动浏览器,截图存到 tmp/ 目录。

say.text: 登录后帮我抓取 news.ycombinator.com 的标题和链接
say.note: 在已登录的 Chrome 里用扩展模式执行。

say.text: 点击页面上“New”链接,然后把新页面标题告诉我
say.note: 会用 ARIA 快照定位元素后点击。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to control a browser: navigate, click, fill forms, etc. Page state persists across script runs, so complex tasks can be done step by step.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to open a URL, click, fill a form, etc., or wants screenshots, data extraction, or website testing. Use extension mode when the user is already logged into a site.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Starts browser and saves screenshot to tmp/.

say_en.text: After login, scrape the headlines and links from news.ycombinator.com.
say_en.note: Runs in extension mode on your logged-in Chrome.

say_en.text: Click the 'New' link on the page and tell me the new page title.
say_en.note: Uses ARIA snapshot refs to locate and click.
